title: Compare routes for two Alabama locations
description: This verifies that a traveler can enter two supported Alabama locations and see a ranked route recommendation with heat exposure details and map overlays.
category: Route Analysis and Thermal Decision Engine

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the origin location with a valid Alabama location
Fill in the destination location with a valid Alabama location
Run the route analysis
Verify a recommended route is displayed
Verify route comparison details are displayed

title: Show a controlled error for unsupported locations
description: This verifies that entering unsupported or invalid coordinates results in a safe error state without showing fabricated route or heat results.
category: Route Analysis and Thermal Decision Engine

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the origin location with an unsupported location
Fill in the destination location with a valid Alabama location
Run the route analysis
Verify a controlled error message is displayed
Verify no route recommendation is displayed

title: Choose a suggested location from autocomplete
description: This verifies that a user can search for a valid Alabama place and select a suggestion so the location is accepted for route analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the origin location with a valid Alabama search query
Wait for location suggestions to appear
Select a suggested origin location
Verify the selected origin location is accepted
Verify usable location coordinates are available for analysis

title: Display candidate routes before selecting the recommended one
description: This verifies that the app shows multiple route options and explains why the recommended route is preferred by heat exposure.
category: Route Analysis and Thermal Decision Engine

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the origin location with a valid Alabama location
Fill in the destination location with a valid Alabama location
Run the route analysis
Verify multiple candidate route cards are displayed
Verify a route explanation is displayed

title: Use preset locations to start route analysis
description: This verifies that a casual user can choose preset Alabama locations and run a route comparison without manual searching.
category: Route Analysis and Thermal Decision Engine

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the preset location selector
Choose a preset origin location
Choose a preset destination location
Run the route analysis
Verify a route recommendation is displayed
Verify route cards are displayed

title: Show a route-not-found or analysis-limit error
description: This verifies that when analysis cannot produce a route, the user sees a controlled failure message instead of route results.
category: Route Analysis and Thermal Decision Engine

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the origin location with a valid Alabama location
Fill in the destination location with a valid Alabama location
Run the route analysis
Verify a route-not-found or analysis-limit message is displayed
Verify no heat exposure results are displayed

title: Show a no-results message for an invalid location search
description: This verifies that a user searching with an invalid location query sees a validation or no-results message instead of an accepted location.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the origin location with an invalid query
Wait for location search to complete
Verify a validation or no-results message is displayed
Verify no selectable location is accepted

title: Confirm service readiness on the health check page
description: This verifies that a developer or operator can open the health check route and confirm the backend is reported as healthy.

steps.description: Navigate to /health
Verify the service health status is displayed
Verify the backend is reported as healthy
